fabrics.name: Lightweight cotton poplin
fabrics.description: A light shirting starting point for shirts and summer dresses.
fabrics.notes: All values are SewEasy starting estimates, not laboratory measurements or a supplier product match. Real fabric varies with yarn, construction and finish.

fabrics.name: Cotton twill
fabrics.description: Cotton twill study sample with published directional bending.
fabrics.notes: Published values transcribed and bending converted from micro-N m to N m. Weight follows the abstract (184 g/m²); section 3.1 reports 208 g/m². The measurement stage is not consistently specified, so weight is labeled reported. Stretch and shear are independent SewEasy estimates; breaking strength was not converted into stretch stiffness. No raw test curves supplied.

weight.source: Akter et al. (2024), doi:10.1002/pls2.10141; CC BY 4.0; abstract, 184 g/m²; section 3.1 lists 208 g/m². Measurement stage is unclear.

bend_weft.source: Akter et al. (2024), doi:10.1002/pls2.10141; CC BY 4.0; section 3.7, 4.3 micro-N m × 1e-6; weft.

fabrics.name: Linen plain weave

fabrics.notes: Table 2 means retained. Weight SD: 1.7 g/m²; thickness SD: 0.01 mm. Bending, stretch and shear are independent SewEasy estimates, not derived from this paper. Its bending-force test and breaking elongation do not directly supply the simulator stiffnesses.

weight.source: Vasile et al. (2024), doi:10.3390/ma17071650; CC BY 4.0; Table 2, FLAX PLAIN; mean 199.7 g/m²; SD 1.7 g/m².

fabrics.name: Cotton blend stretch twill
fabrics.description: A study sample with published weight, thickness and KES bending.
fabrics.notes: Tables 1–2 transcribed; direct KES bending units cN cm converted to N m (× 1e-4). The paper’s CLO bending column differs by a factor of ten after SI conversion; it is not used. Stretch and shear are independent SewEasy estimates, not conversions of proprietary CLO coefficients or single-load elongation. No raw curves supplied.
